name: Khau hang
summary: A grain from gạo tám. Vietnamnet says the paddy is steamed, dried, milled, and steamed again until done. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Vietnamnet, 8 Oct 2015, is the only account. It prints no street.
howToEat: Steam the paddy, dry it, mill off the husk, then steam it until done. A price and a stall hour are Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Khau hang in Dien Bien Phu — steamed twice
seoDescription: Khẩu háng: steam the paddy, dry it, mill it, and steam it again. Vietnamnet prints no street and no price. Check on arrival.
